jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer / Regio Arnhem - Wageningen - Veenendaal - NL
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior .NET Developer | Regio Arnhem - Wageningen - Veenendaal

Bij Sogeti werk je als Senior .NET Developer aan software die ertoe doet. Samen met klanten in de regio bouw je moderne cloud-native applicaties die dagelijks gebruikt worden door medewerkers, klanten en partners. Vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering staan daarbij centraal.

Als strategische Microsoft‑partner met een sterke engineering‑focus investeren we actief in onze Microsoft Community. Je komt terecht in een community waarin kennisdeling, experimenteren en persoonlijke expertiseontwikkeling vanzelfsprekend zijn. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht, externe- en klant-locaties organiseren we maandelijkse Microsoft meet‑ups, deep dives en hands‑on sessies over onder andere .NET, Azure, GitHub, Developer Experience en AI‑gedreven development.

Werken als Senior .NET Developer bij Sogeti

Als Senior .NET Developer werk je binnen DevOps- en productteams aan bedrijfskritische softwareoplossingen. Je ontwikkelt functionaliteit en werkt mee aan architectuur, schaalbaarheid, security en beheerbaarheid. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je werk en signaleert actief verbeterkansen in processen, technologie en samenwerking.

Je werkt voor toonaangevende organisaties in de regio Arnhem, Wageningen en Veenendaal, variërend van telecom en utilities tot overheid, logistiek en zakelijke dienstverlening. Samen met klanten en collega's bouw je oplossingen die langdurig waarde leveren. Daarbij denk je mee over de doorontwikkeling van de oplossing en help je teams om duurzame technische keuzes te maken.

Binnen onze Microsoft Community speel je als senior een zichtbare rol. Je deelt kennis, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en ontwikkelt een eigen visie op onderwerpen als AI-assisted development, cloud-native softwareontwikkeling en moderne engineeringpraktijken.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als .NET Developer.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met .NET Framework/Core, C#, Azure (App Services, Functions), REST API’s en moderne frontend‑ of integratiepatronen.
Je hebt ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, CI/CD, containertechnologie (Docker en/of Kubernetes), en bij voorkeur moderne AI-ondersteunde ontwikkeltools zoals GitHub Copilot.
Je hebt of wilt één of meerdere relevante Microsoft‑certificeringen behalen, zoals Azure Developer Associate (AZ‑204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ‑400) of Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI‑102).
Je bent leergierig, deelt graag kennis en denkt mee over technische strategieën.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.
Je woont bij voorkeur in of nabij de regio Arnhem, Wageningen of Veenendaal

Dit bieden wij jou

Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
Een startsalaris tussen de € 4.500 en € 6.800 bruto per maand per maand (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), afhankelijk van ervaring en aantal werkuren.
Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

jobs.title: Dotnet-ontwikkelaar
jobs.description:
.NET Developer

Deventer | 32 tot 40 uur | Tot € 6.136,02 bruto per maand

Bouw aan de software achter 24 7 hulpverlening

Bij VHD ontwikkelen we software die direct verbonden is met onze dienstverlening. Onze applicaties ondersteunen medewerkers die 24 uur per dag en 7 dagen per week hulp organiseren. Dat vraagt om technologie die betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig is.

Als .NET Developer bouw je mee aan dit bedrijfskritische applicatielandschap.

Je werkt full-stack met onder andere .NET 10, C#, React, microservices, RabbitMQ, MongoDB en SQL Server. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande software en denkt actief mee over architectuur en technische keuzes.

VHD bouwt verder aan een sterk en zelfstandig intern developmentteam. Er liggen meerdere grote projecten klaar waarvoor extra ontwikkelcapaciteit nodig is. Je krijgt dus direct de mogelijkheid om zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Jouw uitdaging

Een van de belangrijkste applicaties is Flex. Binnen dit systeem worden dossiers aangemaakt en koppelingen gelegd met externe systemen, bijvoorbeeld voor het inschakelen van een berger. Voor deze applicatie staat een refactoring van de backend gepland.

Daarnaast is de migratie naar een Docker-omgeving gestart. Jij helpt deze ontwikkeling verder te brengen en draagt bij aan een moderne, beheersbare en schaalbare technische omgeving.

Ontwikkelen vormt de hoofdmoot van je werk. Binnen de sprints ligt de verhouding ongeveer op 70% nieuwe functionaliteiten, 20% bugfixes en 10% technische schuld.

Je werkt binnen een scrumteam met een interne Product Owner en interne en externe developers. Technische keuzes worden binnen het team gemaakt. Van jou verwachten we daarom dat je niet alleen code schrijft, maar ook kritisch meedenkt, een inhoudelijk standpunt inneemt en jouw keuzes helder onderbouwt.

Wat ga je doen?

Nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwikkelen in .NET en React
Bestaande applicaties onderhouden en verbeteren
Bugs oplossen en technische schuld verminderen
Werken aan de backendrefactoring van Flex
Meewerken aan de migratie naar Docker
Backendservices, API’s en systeemkoppelingen ontwikkelen
Werken binnen een microservicesarchitectuur
Meedenken over architectuur en technische standaarden
Bijdragen aan code reviews en kwaliteitsverbetering
Technische keuzes en oplossingen documenteren
Kennis delen met interne en externe developers
Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het interne tech-team

Wie zoeken we?

Je bent een .NET Developer die technisch de diepte in kan en tegelijkertijd verder kijkt dan de code waaraan je op dat moment werkt.

Je brengt mee:
HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau
Ervaring met .NET, ASP.NET, C# en Entity Framework
Ervaring met microservices en API-gebaseerde ontwikkeling
Ervaring met frontendontwikkeling in React
Ervaring met MongoDB en/of SQL Server
Kennis van softwarearchitectuur, design patterns en best practices
Ervaring met refactoring en code-optimalisatie
Ervaring met Agile- en Scrumwerkwijzen
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Ervaring met Docker, RabbitMQ, CI/CD en on-premises infrastructuren is mooi meegenomen.
Minstens zo belangrijk is jouw manier van samenwerken. Je bent communicatief en sociaal vaardig, kunt jouw technische keuzes goed uitleggen en staat open voor de ideeën van anderen. Je neemt eigenaarschap, denkt kritisch mee en draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van het team.

Waarom deze rol?

Omdat je bij VHD niet aan één klein onderdeel van één applicatie werkt.

Je krijgt te maken met verschillende applicaties, microservices, databases en externe koppelingen. Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, refactoring en een migratie naar Docker. Tegelijkertijd krijg je invloed op technische keuzes en de verdere ontwikkeling van het team.

De teamsfeer is informeel en er is ruimte voor humor. Tegelijkertijd begrijpt iedereen de verantwoordelijkheid die hoort bij software voor een organisatie die altijd operationeel moet blijven.

Wat biedt VHD?

Een salaris tot maximaal € 6.136,02 bruto per maand op basis van 39 uur
Een functie van 32, 36 of 40 uur per week
25 vakantiedagen
Bij 40 uur wekelijks één uur ATV, goed voor circa 6,5 extra dagen per jaar
Flexibele werktijden
Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer enkele reis
Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de VHD Academie
Een leasefiets naar keuze bij een vast contract
Een modern kantoor met een bedrijfsrestaurant, dakterras en eigen sportschool
Een informele teamsfeer met ruimte voor humor en inhoudelijke samenwerking
De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan een sterk intern developmentteam

Interesse?

YPD Recruitment verzorgt namens VHD de procedure voor de Senior .NET Developer.
Wil jij bouwen aan een breed applicatielandschap en zichtbaar bijdragen aan de technologie achter 24/7-hulpverlening? Solliciteer dan via het sollicitatieformulier met je cv en motivatie.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Keep our global cloud platform reliable, scalable, and resilient.

Do you enjoy solving complex production challenges before they turn into incidents? Are you the kind of engineer who automates repetitive tasks, improves reliability through engineering, and believes that every outage is an opportunity to build a better system? And are you an experienced, hands-on engineer who wants to stay close to the technology rather than move into people management?

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the Global Platform Team at HeadFirst x Impellam. In this role, you'll help build and operate the cloud platform that powers our global Workforce-as-a-Service (WaaS) ecosystem. You'll work alongside Cloud Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to improve platform resilience, reduce operational overhead, and ensure that our Azure-based engineering environment remains reliable, scalable, and resilient. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with no people management responsibilities.

Your impact

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, your focus is to keep our platforms healthy, reliable, and easy to operate while continuously improving how we build, run and recover production systems.

You'll help build the engineering foundations behind our Headless Data Architecture (HDA), which runs on Azure and Databricks, as well as the Custom Apps Infrastructure (CA) that powers integrations, internal applications, and operational workflows across our international organization.

Instead of spending your days reacting to incidents, you'll focus on preventing them through automation, observability, and reliability engineering. You'll reduce operational burden, improve platform resilience, and build systems that scale, recover automatically whenever possible, and provide engineering teams across Cloud, Data, and AI with the visibility they need to run production workloads with confidence.

What You Will Do

Improve the reliability, availability, and performance of our Azure platform and production environments.
Build and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
Automate operational tasks and eliminate repetitive manual work using Infrastructure as Code and scripting.
Design self-healing capabilities and automated remediation to reduce incidents and improve recovery times.
Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analyses, and implement long-term improvements.
Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
Optimize platform performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Work closely with Cloud Engineers to improve platform design, resilience, security, and operational reliability.
Support Data and AI teams by improving the reliability of Azure Databricks environments.
Help shape and raise engineering standards around observability, automation, and operational excellence.
Continuously look for opportunities to reduce operational complexity and improve developer productivity.
Act as a technical point of reference for reliability engineering, helping shape technical decisions while remaining hands-on in the technology.

About The Role

As part of the Global Platform Team, you'll work alongside engineers in Cloud, Data, and AI to improve the reliability of our Azure-based platform. Using technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Databricks, GitHub Actions, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, you'll help ensure that our global Workforce-as-a-Service ecosystem remains reliable, scalable, and resilient.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will have significant technical ownership and will be expected to get into the detail when needed, from troubleshooting complex production issues to improving automation, observability and system reliability. You will act as a technical reference point for others, but you will not have people management responsibilities.

About HeadFirst x Impellam

HeadFirst x Impellam is one of Europe's leading providers of workforce and talent solutions. Operating across multiple countries, we are transforming into a cloud-native, AI-powered organization that connects people, technology, and data through a modern digital platform. The Global Platform Team is at the heart of that transformation, enabling engineering teams across Cloud, Data, AI, and Software Engineering to build and operate scalable solutions for the future.

Here’s what we offer you

Salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring

Je ontvangt een range aan salaris dat aansluit op jouw kennis en ervaring. We belonen je eerlijk voor je inzet en ontwikkeling.

Vakantiegeld en vrije dagen

Je ontvangt 8,33% vakantiegeld en hebt recht op 27 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. Zo heb je voldoende ruimte om op te laden.

Hybride werken

Wij ondersteunen hybride werken en hanteren hiervoor een 60/40-verdeling, waarbij je bij een fulltime dienstverband drie dagen op kantoor bent en twee dagen vanuit huis kunt werken.

Premievrij pensioen

Wij betalen jouw volledige pensioenpremie. Je bouwt dus pensioen op zonder dat je daar zelf aan bijdraagt. Je houdt hierdoor een hoger nettosalaris over.

Prestatiebonus

Afhankelijk van jouw prestaties én die van HeadFirst Group kun je jaarlijks een extra beloning ontvangen van één of twee maandsalarissen.

Maandelijkse extra’s

Je ontvangt een maandelijkse vergoeding voor internet, een vitaliteitsbudget, een bijdrage voor lunch en ondersteuning bij het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek.

What we expect from you

What You’ll Bring

You're passionate about building reliable systems and solving operational challenges through engineering rather than manual intervention. You enjoy understanding how distributed systems behave, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are always looking for ways to improve automation, resilience, and observability. You stay calm under pressure, take ownership of problems, and enjoy collaborating with others to continuously improve the platform's reliability.

You have significant experience operating production systems and still enjoy getting hands-on. You are comfortable working independently, making technical decisions and going deep into complex problems. While you may naturally act as a technical reference point for others, you are not looking for a people management role.

7+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Cloud Engineer, with significant hands-on experience in production environments.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics.
Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
Experience supporting distributed cloud platforms in production.
Experience with incident management, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements.
Familiarity with GitOps principles and modern deployment practices.
Experience with Azure Databricks is a strong advantage.
Experience with SnapLogic or similar integration platforms is a plus.
A strong preference for staying hands-on and solving technical problems directly, rather than moving into people management.

Practical information

Location: Hoofddorp, North Holland, Netherlands
Working model: Hybrid, 60/40, with regular presence at our Hoofddorp office.
Language: English is required. Dutch is a plus.
Work authorisation: You should already be based in the Netherlands. Visa sponsorship may be available where applicable. We do not provide relocation support.

Interested?

If you're an experienced SRE who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, staying hands-on with technology, and taking ownership of production reliability, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Stage Centraal Feedback Platform
jobs.description:
Wil jij impact maken op IT-dienstverlening en leren hoe je feedback structureert en benut? Bij a.s.r. werk je aan een slimme aanpak voor het verzamelen en verbeteren van feedback. Binnen a.s.r. werken we continu aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening richting interne IT-gebruikers. Daarbij is feedback van gebruikers essentieel. Denk aan developers, architecten en andere teams die dagelijks gebruikmaken van platformdiensten.
Op dit moment komt feedback via verschillende kanalen binnen, waardoor overzicht en prioritering lastig zijn. Daarom starten we met Azure als concrete eerste casus: een veelgebruikt platform met een duidelijke en urgente behoefte aan betere feedbackstructurering.

Het doel van deze stage gaat echter verder dan alleen Azure. We willen een aanpak ontwikkelen die herbruikbaar is voor bredere IT-dienstverlening binnen de organisatie. Azure fungeert hierbij als startpunt om te leren, te testen en te verbeteren.Tijdens deze stage onderzoek jij hoe we feedback slimmer kunnen organiseren. Eerst voor Azure, maar met het oog op schaalbaarheid naar andere diensten

Dit ga je doen tijdens je Stage Centraal Feedback Platform bij a.s.r.
Je onderzoekt hoe feedback op Azure én vergelijkbare diensten nu wordt verzameld en verwerkt
Je haalt behoeften op bij gebruikers en stakeholders, met aandacht voor bredere toepasbaarheid
Je verkent bestaande oplossingen die generiek inzetbaar zijn
Je bepaalt welke oplossing(en) het beste passen bij a.s.r., zowel voor Azure als voor bredere dienstverlening

As a family-owned enterprise, we prioritize values such as trust, dependability, and teamwork, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. Our commitment to shaping the future of mobility is reflected in our continuous pursuit of technological excellence and sustainable development.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior C# / .NET Software Developer (m/w/d) to join our team in Mönchengladbach. This role is pivotal in advancing our industrial applications within the Operational Technology division. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and modernizing software solutions that directly impact our production and logistics processes. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to create practical, efficient, and scalable software systems that integrate seamlessly with existing ERP, production, and third-party systems. Solid knowledge of databases, preferably Oracle and MS SQL Server.

Excellent command of German and good proficiency in English; valid work authorization for the EU.

Actively shape the digital future of our production by developing and modernizing applications for manufacturing and logistics.

Create and maintain integrations between ERP, production, warehouse, and third-party systems to streamline workflows.
Translate complex business and technical requirements into sustainable and innovative software solutions.
Enhance our API and integration landscape by developing scalable and robust interfaces.
Evaluate emerging technologies and drive digitalization initiatives to keep our systems at the forefront of innovation.
Serve as a technical point of contact for internal teams and business units, providing expertise and support for digital transformation projects.

Benefits

Secure, permanent employment in an established and innovative company that values diversity and equality.

Additional perks such as bike leasing, access to Urban Sports Club, and a subsidy for childcare.

Opportunities for continuous professional development through targeted training and development programs.
Competitive salary package coupled with a collegial, respectful workplace environment that recognizes and values your contributions.

Equal Opportunity

Scheidt & Bachmann GmbH is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated and all employees have equal access to opportunities, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und trägst aktiv zum Erfolg deines Projektteams bei
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1 Level) und sehr gut Englisch (mindestens B2)

Unser Angebot an dich:

Wertschätzung & Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr
Fachlicher Austausch & Wissenstransfer: 14 interne Communities & Netzwerke (z. B. ML, Green IT, Architektur, IoT)
Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice-Anteil
Jobrad, Workation, Sabbatical, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss, Gesundheitsprogramme und vieles mehr
Faires Gehaltsmodell: Finale Vergütung richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikation und bisherigen Erfahrung

, indem wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zukunftssichere Softwareentwicklung und messbaren Impact schaffen. Dabei steht der Mensch im Fokus

Our customers are auditors, risk managers, and compliance teams, which means evaluation rigor, auditability, and EU AI Act readiness aren't afterthoughts for us. They're product requirements.

Tasks
As an Application Architect
(m/f/d), you will be one of the first full-time senior engineers and collaborate closely with our Co-Founder and CTO. You will own the backend architecture and help the team scale quality and delivery speed.

In the first 6–12 months you will have:

established a clear target architecture and documentation baseline using Arc42

clarified and communicated the core domain model using DDD
principles

introduced/standardized an AI-driven development process
, from feature specs to production deployment

strengthened engineering practices via coaching, pairing, and feedback loops (especially for junior developers)

improved reliability and delivery through better CI/CD
, test automation, and infrastructure hygiene

Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to find strong solutions to new types of problems in an AI-first architecture

Drive a DevOps-style approach across the full specification → development → delivery lifecycle (inspired by the DevOps Handbook )

Propose and implement approaches to make delivery faster and more reliable
(e.g., improving flow, feedback loops, and recovery)

Implement and evolve monitoring/observability across systems (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) so we can detect issues early and learn from production

Coach and collaborate with junior developers on good development, design and architecture practices

Collaborate with the team to develop an AI-driven development process
from feature specs down to production deployment

Plan & document backend architecture in the Arc42 framework

Extend & communicate the domain model using DDD principles

Manage and extend application infrastructure on Azure
with Pulumi

Requirements
Absolute must-haves:

experience with Arc42 framework (ISAQB)
and C4

experience leading
and enabling
development teams

deep Java SpringBoot (MVC, JPA, Security)
experience

solid knowledge of Design Patterns
and Domain Driven Design

excellent code quality based on Clean Code & SOLID principles

deep experience with TDD & BDD

full stack
web dev experience (React, Angular)

Strong candidates will also bring...

Azure or AWS infrastructure-as-code with Pulumi

A strong DevOps mindset (the DevOps Handbook is your bible) and experience building:

reliable CI/CD pipelines and release processes

production-grade monitoring/observability and incident response practices

continuous improvement loops (post-incident reviews, operational learning, and prioritizing reliability work)

Claude Code (or comparable AI-assisted development workflows)

IntelliJ power-user

Benefits

Hands-on ownership of a real AI product used by enterprise customers

Work directly alongside the founding team from day one

Hybrid work model: Munich North, minimum one day per week in the office, otherwise flexible (open to strong candidates elsewhere in the EU for the right fit); onboarding will take in-office

A steep learning curve at the intersection of LLM engineering, enterprise GRC, and startup operations

The chance to shape the AI team as we grow

Auxilius .ai is building AI-powered GRC solutions for enterprises. We're early-stage, fast-growing, and backed by real customers. Our tech stack includes Java & Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes on Azure, and OpenAI & Anthropic LLMs.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Nutrient

At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical.

Your Role at Nutrient...

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer:

You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start.
Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product.

Here’s How This Role Is Different

If you are a solutions engineer today, the difference is that you ship.
If you are a professional services engineer today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product.
If you are a product engineer today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed.

What You'll Work On...

Discover the problem before anyone scopes it. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request.
Build the first implementation yourself. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal.
Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it. Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result.
Stitch across the whole platform. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving.
Productize what you build. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self-service features.
Close the loop back into the company. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting.
Support the deal. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win.

What You'll Bring...

The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution.

You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:

You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done.
You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well.
You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution.
You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C#, Java, Python or Go, and you pick up the others without drama.
You can stand up and reason about infrastructure: containers, Kubernetes, at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, reverse proxies and load balancing, Postgres, Redis.
You have worked with LLMs in production, not only in a notebook. Prompt and retrieval design, evaluating extraction quality, cost and latency tuning.
You write well. Design docs, scorecards, handover notes and customer-facing summaries are part of the output, not overhead.

It Would Be Nice If You Have

Document technology background: PDF internals, OCR, layout-aware extraction, e-signature flows, redaction.
Domain time in heavily regulated industries, such as banking KYC, insurance claims, or healthcare and life sciences.
Experience in a forward deployed, solutions architecture or founding-engineer role at an infrastructure or platform company.
Consulting or agency background, if you left it because you wanted the work to compound.
Integration experience with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011.
Comfort working with regulated environments and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud.

Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:

You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn.
You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it.
You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use.

Also…

Your first 90 days: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why.
How we will measure your impact: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company.
Team and location: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs.

Who Thrives Here...

At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

Collaborators: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego.
Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth.
Curious Thinkers: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right.
Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence.
Owners: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control.
Doers: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges.

Why You'll Love Working Here...

At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

Real technical ownership: you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers.
Cross-functional influence: your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy.
Distributed and async-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
Mission-critical product: Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries.
Strong growth trajectory: ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners.

Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non-merit factor.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer works day-to-day on all aspects of managing and maintaining the  cloud infrastructure environments that support the software platform we provide to our customers, as  well as our internal systems. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role operating within a regulated  financial services environment, where our infrastructure is directly accessed by customers and  connected to third-party trading, settlement and market data services. 

The successful candidate will combine strong core Azure and Windows infrastructure skills with genuine  depth in networking, firewalling, directory services and database administration. They will be  comfortable owning complex, business-critical migrations end-to-end, liaising directly with vendors and  customers, and producing high-quality documentation to support the wider team and our audit and  compliance obligations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Managing internal and customer server infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, including VMs, Network Security Groups, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways/WAF and other key Azure resources. 
• Designing, configuring and troubleshooting network connectivity between customers, third  parties and our platform, including site-to-site VPNs, routing, NAT/PAT and DNS.
• Administering internal and customer-facing firewalls, in particular Fortinet FortiGate
• Building and maintaining connectivity to external trading, settlement and market data services  (e.g. payment/settlement gateways such as CREST, and trading interfaces).
• Administering and maintaining Active Directory, including trusts, Kerberos delegation, certificate services and certificate lifecycle management.
• Maintaining and supporting Microsoft SQL Server, including patching, monitoring and day-to-day administration, and maintaining our high availability and disaster recovery configurations.
• Testing and maintaining backups and DR processes (including invocation testing) to ensure they meet contracted RPO/RTO obligations.
• Managing and maintaining the Microsoft 365 environment and associated tools.
• Maintaining external-facing infrastructure (e.g. web servers, reverse proxies, DNS and public certificates).
• Routine patching and maintenance of servers and firewalls.
• Maintenance of our software and associated components on Third Platform Services (TPS).
• Responding to IT audit and customer due-diligence information requests and providing  supporting evidence. 
• Work alongside group information security to ensure infrastructure is designed, configured and  maintained in line with security policies, control frameworks and audit requirements, and to  support remediation of identified risks and vulnerabilities. 
• Managing relationships with third-party vendors and suppliers (e.g. Microsoft, Fortinet,  connectivity and settlement providers), including technical liaison, escalations and coordinating  delivery of changes.
• Producing and maintaining clear technical documentation, runbooks and knowledgebase articles to support the team, ensure resilience of knowledge, and satisfy audit requirements.
• Monitoring and responding to alerts as they arise from the infrastructure and monitoring platforms.
• Out-of-hours work for routine maintenance and occasional project work.
• Working on other IT projects relating to infrastructure and security as required.
• Contributing to team planning.

KEY ATTRIBUTES AND SKILLS 
Essential

• Proven experience in a similar technical role involving infrastructure and cloud  technology.
• Experience in an environment providing and supporting B2B customer-facing technology.
• Experience working within a regulated or externally audited industry, with an understanding of contractual obligations and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 / ISAE 3402 / AAF, and  CIS benchmarks/controls (or equivalents such as NIST).
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Self-motivated, and capable of tackling complex projects either on their own or as part of a team.
• Able to work collaboratively across different departments/teams with differing technical capabilities, and with external customers and vendors, to deliver effective solutions.
• Proven experience with Microsoft Azure and Windows Server administration.
• Strong networking and firewalling depth, in particular NAT/PAT, site-to-site (IPsec) VPN, routing and DNS.
• Advanced Active Directory administration, including trusts, Kerberos delegation and certificate management.
• Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD in depth – Enterprise applications, SSO, Conditional Access, hybrid identity.
• Microsoft SQL Server administration – backup/restore and recovery, security/permissions, SQL Agent job management.
• Knowledge of Windows-based IIS application administration.
• PowerShell scripting.
• Office 365 administration and automation.
• Experience with backup and DR tools and processes.
• Strong documentation skills and experience managing third-party vendors/suppliers.

Desirable 

• Microsoft Dynamics CRM administration.
• ADFS administration.
• SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery design: e.g. Always On availability groups, clustering, log shipping.
• Microsoft BizTalk Server and Microsoft SharePoint Server administrator.
• Fortinet/FortiGate firewall administration.                                                                                      
• Experience with PRTG, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.
• Atlassian suite – Jira ticketing and project management, Confluence documentation

Industry-specific experience:

• Payment/settlement gateways (e.g. CREST/Euroclear), trading  interfaces, CASS, and similar financial-market infrastructure.
• Wealth management / stockbroking domain knowledge.
• Understanding of modern infrastructure automation such as Terraform.

A little about us  
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.  

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too.  

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact.  

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work.  

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus  
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion.  
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector.  

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development.  

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

At IMServ Europe Ltd, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About The Role

The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMServ's Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. The pair share the full scope so that no environment, pipeline or release depends on any one individual. This role sits within our Scrum teams, working day to day with Software Engineers, Testers and the Technical Architect. Where they own the code, you own the platform it ships on, through the entire product lifecycle.

Qualifications

Essential:

Has 5+ years running production Azure environments as their primary discipline (App Services, Azure SQL, storage, networking fundamentals).
Has written and maintained CI/CD, build and deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML), including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables.
Routinely practices infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM or Terraform) and is a confident scripter in PowerShell and the Azure CLI.
Strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design: Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC and least privilege.
Has owned monitoring, backup and disaster recovery for a live service (Application Insights, Log Analytics), including responding to and resolving incidents.
Has worked in an Agile SCRUM team and is familiar with the associated ceremonies and artefacts.
Understands SQL Server well enough to manage environment data, refreshes and test data safely (in a Relational Database system).

Desirable

Microsoft certification: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Has run or supported one or more of the following Azure PaaS services: Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory / Synapse / Microsoft Fabric.
Enough C# / .NET to read application code and debug a failing build alongside the engineers.
Experience consolidating single-tenant, per-client deployments into a shared multi-tenant platform.
Experience of enterprise client security requirements (supplier security reviews, ISO 27001-style controls, penetration test remediation).
Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work.

Responsibilities

Environment management. Provision, configure and maintain the Astral environment estate (development, test, UAT/load and production), keeping environments consistent, reproducible and documented through infrastructure as code. Manage environment refreshes and test data in line with our data protection rules.
CI/CD pipelines. Build, maintain and continuously improve our Azure DevOps build, test and release pipelines, including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidate duplicated per-client pipelines toward a single deployment path as the platform moves to multi-tenancy.
Release management. Plan and execute deployments through the environment chain to production, with rehearsed rollback for every release. Support product go-lives and maintain a clear, communicated release calendar.
Security and access. Own secrets and certificate management (Azure Key Vault, managed identities), role-based access control and least-privilege across the estate, and platform patching. Work with IT security on audit remediation and the security release plan.
Monitoring, reliability and recovery. Own observability (Application Insights, Log Analytics), alerting, backups and disaster recovery, including periodic DR tests. Lead incident response for platform issues and run blameless root-cause reviews.
Cost management. Monitor and optimise Azure spend across environments and clients; right-size resources and report on cost drivers.
Documentation and knowledge. Keep runbooks, environment documentation and configuration records current, written up the same day work is done. We are removing single points of failure, not creating new ones.
Community membership. Be an active member of the Scrum team and the wider Product Engineering community, taking part in sprint ceremonies, the Innovation Forum and team events, and unblocking engineers' environment and pipeline needs quickly.

28 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays
Buy & sell annual leave scheme
Up to a 10% bonus
Enhanced salary sacrifice pension
Life assurance (up to 6x salary)
Simply Health plan (with upgrade options)
Car salary sacrifice scheme

(Length of service and T&Cs apply)

jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla marknadens smartaste betal- och finansieringslösningar? Vi söker en senior fullstackutvecklare som vill ta plats i en affärsnära roll där ditt arbete gör verklig skillnad. Hos oss blir du en nyckelspelare i ett självorganiserande, tvärfunktionellt team där innovation, samarbete och ansvar går hand i hand.

Om rollen

Du blir en del av utvecklingsteamet inom Sveas affärsområde Payments, som erbjuder betal- och finansieringslösningar för både e-handel och fysisk handel. Teamet arbetar med att utveckla och underhålla affärsområdets egenutvecklade system och applikationer. Vi utvecklar främst i .NET C#, React och Vue.js

Vem är du?

Vi letar efter dig som brinner för hög kodkvalitet, tycker om att lösa komplexa problem och trivs med att omvandla idéer till lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för våra kunder. Du är självgående och gillar en föränderlig miljö och kan snabbt sätta dig in i komplexa problem samt ge förslag på tekniska lösningar. Du vill förstå affären och bidra till den tekniska riktningen framåt. Vi ser att du är en engagerad lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta mot gemensamma mål och ser styrkan i samarbete. Du är också kommunikativ och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap till kollegor i och utanför teamet.

Erfarenheter och kvalifikationer

Mycket goda kunskaper i .NET C#
Mycket goda kunskaper i React (kunskaper i Vue.js är meriterande).
Goda kunskaper inom kvalitetssäkring och automatisering av test
Högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap eller motsvarande
Minst 5+ års erfarenhet av arbete inom systemutveckling
Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både tal och skrift

Meriterande med erfarenhet av att jobba inom Bank & Finans med insyn i regulatoriska krav samt förmåga att förstå verksamhetskrav och omsätta i kundnytta samt erfarenhet av arbete i tvärfunktionella team.

Om Svea

Svea är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i flertalet europeiska länder. Med mer än 40 års erfarenhet är vi stolta över att erbjuda innovativa och hållbara finansiella lösningar till våra kunder. Svea präglas av en familjär företagskultur där varje medarbetare bidrar med sin unika kompetens och engagemang. Vår företagskultur betonar gemenskap, handlingskraft, och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Välkommen att följa med oss på vår spännande resa!

Ansökan

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och vi önskar att tillsätta tjänsten så snart som möjligt så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Har du frågor kring tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterare Johanna Rooth på johanna.rooth@svea.com

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: SAP business architect (Order to cash)Swedish nationals
jobs.description:
SAP Business Architect, Order to Cash

Experience:
10 to 15 years overall IT, with 5 or more years hands-on in SAP order to cash.

Location:
On-site at Sodertalje, Sweden.

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on SAP Business Architect to own the order to cash process within a multi-year SAP transformation programme. This is not a purely solution architect role but the person will have a strong SAP solution architect or technical background and must operate from a broader business perspective, owning the process end to end and driving change management across business units.
This is a hands-on delivery role rather than a supervisory one. The successful candidate personally designs, documents, and drives the process rather than delegating the work to others.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end to end order to cash business process design for the commercial business.
Set up commercial order flows in SAP and configure the process to match agreed business rules.
Work closely with finance on the financial model being implemented, keeping the commercial flow and the financial design aligned.
Maintain the link to plan to fulfill so that available to promise behaves correctly across the order flow.
Secure a consistent order to cash flow across a two ERP landscape, including the link to Microsoft Dynamics 365 used for wholesale and retail.
Document and maintain the process model in ARIS using BPMN 2.0, and keep it current as the design evolves.
Act as the business counterpart to the IT-side solution architect, translating business intent into implementable process design.
Facilitate design workshops, resolve design conflicts, and take decisions at process level across several business units and alongside the global implementation partner.
Drive change management and business adoption of the new process.
Personally execute the analysis, design, and documentation work, and transfer knowledge to the permanent organisation.

Required Skills and Experience

10 to 15 years in IT, with 5 or more years hands-on in SAP order to cash.
Deep SAP background with demonstrable ability to set up commercial order flows, covering sales order management, pricing, delivery, billing, and credit management.
Genuine techno-functional depth, with the ability to work at configuration and integration level rather than at presentation level only.
Strong working interface with finance, covering revenue recognition, financial postings, and the integration between the commercial flow and the finance model.
Practical understanding of the link from order to cash into plan to fulfill and manufacturing planning, specifically for available to promise.
Experience of operating in a multi ERP landscape and keeping a single business process consistent across two systems.
Structured business process documentation and modelling in ARIS using BPMN 2.0, with the discipline to keep the model current through a live programme.
Strong technical background in SAP.
Proven change management capability in a multi stakeholder environment.
Track record of individual delivery in a programme environment: an executor rather than a programme manager.

Nice to Have

Automotive and commercial vehicle manufacturing domain experience, covering trucks, buses, and industrial power solutions.
Familiarity with automotive make to order logic based on product individuals rather than articles.
Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 in wholesale and retail order flows.
Experience on large SAP S/4HANA transformation programmes delivered with a global implementation partner in a multi vendor setup.
Working knowledge of Swedish.

Soft Skills

Strong client-facing communication in written and spoken English.
Consulting mindset with disciplined problem-solving.
Able to operate independently and hands-on within a collaborative, multi-stakeholder setup.
Strong documentation, facilitation, and stakeholder alignment skills.
Change management orientation, comfortable driving adoption rather than only designing.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Team: Engineering - Location: Stockholm

Pacera unifies financial close, consolidation and FP&A into one intelligent platform. With AARO, Aico and Mercur, finance teams turn trusted data into AI-driven insight — powering robust, scalable, and smarter decision-making for the Office of the CFO.

About The Role

We're looking for a Mid/Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure team of 6 and help operate and maintain the production environment behind our SaaS platform. You'll work across a hybrid environment of Windows and Linux virtual machines, supporting applications built on .NET and Java, running on top of VMware and OpenStack, with some services also running in Azure.

Our environment relies heavily on client VPNs and IPSEC point-to-point tunnels for remote and site connectivity, so extensive networking and firewall skills are essential.

We manage our infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, so solid coding/scripting skills are necessary for this role. This is a hands-on operational role focused on keeping our platform reliable, secure, and performing well in production.

What You'll Do

Maintain and monitor production infrastructure for our SaaS platform, ensuring high availability and performance
Manage and troubleshoot both Windows and Linux virtual machines in production environments
Administer and optimize virtualization infrastructure on VMware and OpenStack
Manage and troubleshoot client VPN access and IPSEC point-to-point tunnels, working with firewalls and network infrastructure
Support the deployment, monitoring, and performance of .NET and Java applications running in production
Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code to provision, configure, and manage our environment
Respond to and resolve incidents, performing root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
Perform routine maintenance tasks: patching, updates, backups, and capacity planning
Log, track, and update work using our ticketing system; collaborate with development teams to support releases and deployments into production
Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and automation to reduce manual operational work
Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbook

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

Several years' hands-on experience administering both Windows Server and Linux environments in production
Experience with OpenStack or comparable private cloud/IaaS platforms
Familiarity supporting production applications built on Java
Solid networking and firewall knowledge, including experience with client VPNs and IPSEC site-to-site tunnels
Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, OS, and application layers
Comfortable owning incidents in a production environment with high uptime requirements
Solid coding/scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) and experience with Infrastructure as Code
Experience with Datadog or similar observability platforms
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bicep
Experience working with Jira or a similar ticketing/issue-tracking system

Nice-to-haves:

Experience with NixOS
Experience with container-based environments (e.g Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience with Microsoft Azure (or another public cloud) in a production setting
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
Familiarity with firewall platforms (Clavister, Fortinet)
Relevant certifications (VMware VCP, Linux, Microsoft/Azure, OpenStack, or networking certs like CCNA)
Prior experience in a SaaS or always-on production environment

What We Offer

The opportunity to be part of our next phase of growth and expansion, backed by strategic private equity investment
Competitive compensation and benefits package including pension, flex hours, wellness allowances and more
Hybrid working options

About Pacera

Pacera is redefining financial operations for the Office of the CFO — powering planning, financial close, consolidation, and reporting through one unified platform, trusted by 700+ organisations and 70,000+ users across more than 140 countries.

Our platform brings together three specialised products — Aico by Pacera
, AARO by Pacera
, and Mercur by Pacera
— giving finance teams the accuracy, control, and confidence they need to run mission-critical operations, without compromise.

Aico automates and streamlines financial close processes
Mercur powers FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, business intelligence, and financial analytics
AARO delivers consolidation and group reporting solutions

Each product has a loyal customer base and a strong track record of growth. Built on decades of proven expertise, our platform helps finance and executive leaders automate, govern, and make faster, smarter decisions.

We're headquartered in Stockholm, with offices across Sweden, Finland, Latvia, and the UK. And we're driven by the same principles wherever we are: collaboration, continuous learning, flexibility, curiosity, and the drive to win together.

Backed by Accel-KKR, a global technology-focused investment firm, the group has ambitious growth plans driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. We are now strengthening our operations by investing in key roles that support our platform and future scalability.

Apply now

This is a permanent, full-time position. The role will be based in Stockholm.

We warmly welcome your application.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer with Next.js
jobs.description:
Would you like to make an impact on our 3.8 million customers across the Nordic region? You could become one of us in the Digital services unit, where modern technologies, smart design, and user experience are key drivers. We are now looking for a motivated and talented individual to join one of our teams.

About The Role

We're excited to introduce Next.js into our development landscape and are looking for someone with strong expertise in the framework to help lead the journey. You will act as a catalyst for adoption, mentoring team members, promoting best practices, and strengthening the team's overall capability in Next.js.

Working in one of our cross-functional agile teams, you will help design and deliver web services that provide smooth customer experiences across the Nordic countries.

Together with your team, you will build web solutions and APIs using Azure-hosted services, leveraging C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web APIs, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and Razor.

Test automation and continuous integration are a natural part of your workflow. You will also collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and refine user stories.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

Our web applications provide Nordic customers with modern self-service solutions for managing insurance, claims, and payments. The team continuously improves these services and develops APIs that support other digital channels, including mobile apps.

You will join a cross-functional agile team with colleagues in Turku, Espoo, Riga, and Stockholm. The team is supportive, ambitious, and committed to continuous improvement. As part of the Oasis tribe, you will help deliver services that keep customers well supported, informed, and correctly insured across the Nordics. Although the team works across multiple locations, there are regular opportunities to meet colleagues in person.

You will also be part of a chapter, a community of developers with similar competencies. Chapters help ensure our teams have the technical capabilities they need today and in the future. Together with your peers, you will shape learning topics, share knowledge, and grow your expertise with support from your Chapter Lead.

Beyond your immediate team, you will be part of a broader developer community across Espoo, Turku, and Riga, providing plenty of opportunities to learn, collaborate, and connect with colleagues. Read more about our tech community.

Read more about our tech community.

Who are you?

You are passionate about development in an agile environment and contributing to software development and operations initiatives in your team. You enjoy sharing your Next.js expertise, coaching colleagues, and helping them build confidence in the framework. You are motivated by quality and good design and are always eager to learn more.

You Also Have

Multiple years of experience in software development (mid or senior level)
Deep knowledge of backend software development with C#/.NET
Good understanding of REST API development (.NET)
Front-end development experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript
Experience with Azure, Git environments, pull requests, and code reviews
Solid understanding of HTML and CSS (tailwind)
Experience with integration of third-party services via API
Strong communication skills to articulate complex concepts and logic to non-technical stakeholders and cross-functional teams
Problem-solving and adaptability, including critical thinking and resourceful solution design
Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with practices such as code reviews and pair programming
Fluent English skills, both spoken and written
Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, other AI assistants or agentic development is an advantage
Experience with SQL Server, Entity Framework, or NoSQL
Relevant bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent work experience

Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, the application deadline is 11.10.2026.

Please attach your CV

Espoo or Turku (Finland)

Occasional travel within the Nordic and Baltic countries

Start:
As soon as possible or by agreement

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect/Lead (.NET & Azure)
to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale, cloud-native solutions built on the Microsoft technology stack.

This role combines solution architecture, technical leadership, engineering governance, and hands-on guidance of development teams. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, project managers, business analysts, architects, developers, UI/UX teams, and client representatives to design secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable solutions.
The individual will be responsible for driving architecture decisions, establishing technical standards, mentoring engineering teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design

Design enterprise-grade application architectures using Microsoft technologies and Azure cloud services.
Define solution blueprints, architecture standards, and technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives.
Review and approve technical designs, solution approaches, and implementation strategies.
Establish architectural patterns that support scalability, resiliency, maintainability, security, and performance.
Lead architecture reviews, technical governance activities, and design assurance processes.
Drive application modernization and cloud migration initiatives.
Design mission-critical and highly available systems.
Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Event-Driven Architecture principles where appropriate.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple development teams.
Mentor developers, technical leads, and engineering teams to drive technical excellence.
Promote best practices, engineering standards, and sound architectural decision-making.
Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews.
Support project planning, estimation, risk management, and delivery activities.
Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the software development lifecycle.

Cloud & Integration Architecture

Architect and design cloud-native solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure services.
Design microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven platforms.
Define enterprise integration strategies, patterns, and best practices.
Support cloud transformation, modernization, and platform migration programs.
Design highly available, resilient, and scalable platforms to meet business and operational requirements.

Engineering Excellence

Promote Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and secure coding practices.
Establish standards for CI/CD, DevOps, testing, monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability requirements.
Review non-functional requirements and ensure compliance with architectural and security standards.
Advocate engineering excellence and continuous improvement practices.

Stakeholder Management

Engage with clients and stakeholders through technical discussions, workshops, and solution presentations.
Translate business requirements into practical and effective technical solutions.
Communicate architecture decisions and recommendations to both business and technical audiences.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction.

Technical Requirements

Backend & .NET Technologies

.NET 8+, .NET Core, and C#
ASP.NET Core / MVC
RESTful API Design and Development
Microservices Architecture
Entity Framework Core
Dependency Injection
Asynchronous Programming
Clean Architecture and SOLID Principles

Cloud & Azure

Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Azure App Services
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Storage Accounts
Azure Application Insights

jobs.description:
Location:

Function:
IT Infrastructure, Cloud Architecture and Engineering

Head of Engineering and IT

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital is a Singapore headquartered multi-strategy hedge fund managing approximately USD 5 billion in assets. Founded in Singapore and built around Asian markets, we run a range of strategies across macro, commodities, and systematic trading. We employ around 350 people across nine offices globally, with Singapore as our headquarters and primary technology hub. We are regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under the regulatory regimes of the markets in which we invest.

The IT Infrastructure function is organized across four pillars: Network, Windows, Linux, and Cloud. It is a lean six-person team of senior engineers, working in close partnership with the Cybersecurity function and with the trading and research desks it supports.

This role owns the cloud and productivity platform. That means both the architecture and the hands that build it. There is no separate engineering layer to hand designs to. You will define the landing zone, build it, migrate workloads onto it, and run it. We are not looking for a design-only architect.

The estate is Microsoft-centric. Azure runs on a hub-and-spoke topology out of Singapore, connected to our offices over ExpressRoute and VPN, and we run Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID, and Intune alongside it. There is a substantial program ahead: migrating remaining on-premises workloads to Azure, modernizing legacy applications onto platform services, and building out the data platform. Uptime and latency affect trading and research directly, so resilience and change discipline matter more here than breadth of technology. We want streamlined platforms sized for a fast-moving fund, not the complexity of a large bank.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Azure landing zone architecture, including subscription and management group design, governance guardrails, and policy baselines, right sized to the firm rather than to enterprise scale.
Design and build the Azure network fabric alongside the Network Architect, covering hub-and-spoke topology, peering, security groups, and hybrid connectivity across Azure Arc, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
Own the design and configuration of Azure Firewall, including forced tunnelling and traffic routing between DMZ and production environments.
Lead cloud migration strategy and execution, moving on-premises workloads to Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS with clear cutover and rollback plans.
Re-architect and modernize legacy applications onto Azure Web Apps and platform services, improving scalability, fault tolerance, and API-based integration.
Build and maintain the data platform architecture, integrating Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Microsoft Purview for data governance and lineage.
Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online, including mailbox management, conditional access, and email security, alongside Intune device management and compliance policy.
Design and test disaster recovery and backup strategies, and own monitoring and alerting across Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, ensuring telemetry is available to the security operations function.
Optimize cloud spend through autoscaling, resource right-sizing, and reservation strategy, and report on run-rate and forecast.
Implement platform security controls including Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and encryption, aligned to MAS Technology Risk Management guidelines and NIST CSF 2.0, with cybersecurity architecture review as a required gate on new designs.

Requirements

8 or more years in cloud and infrastructure roles, including at least 3 years carrying architecture and design ownership. Experience in a regulated financial services environment is advantageous.
Currently hands-on. You should be actively building and operating cloud infrastructure today, not directing others who do.
Demonstrated track record designing and delivering enterprise cloud migrations across hybrid environments, end to end.
Expert-level Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS design and operation, with Azure CLI, PowerShell, and infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep.
Azure networking, including virtual networks, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Traffic Manager, Azure Firewall, and security groups.
Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration, including conditional access, email security, and Intune device management and compliance.
Identity and platform security, including Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud.
Application modernization, including legacy-to-platform migration, Azure Web Apps, and API-based re-architecture, alongside data services such as Azure SQL, Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks.
DevOps and automation, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker and Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Delivered platform builds or migrations in a lean team. Available to execute out-of-hours cutover windows, with communication skills to articulate the business value of technical work.

Preferred certifications: AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AZ-104 Azure Administrator Associate. AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer Associate and multi-cloud experience with AWS or Google Cloud are advantageous.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.
